6 Questions to Ask When Hiring a Web Design Agency

Hiring a web agency can be a daunting task. Whether you have had a bad experience with a previous web designer, or you are ready to build a brand spanking new site, there are questions to ask when hiring the right agency partner.

  • What services do you offer?
  • How do you price your services?
  • What is your business structure?
  • What is your process in creating a new website?
  • How will my project be managed?
  • Do you get good feels?

Your web agency is more than your developer, they are your digital marketing partners. Your website should support your business goals. Make sure you choose the web agency who works to build with you, not just for you.
